reviews_1s:
I searched to find a funnel that was made in America not China thinking it would be good quality . the first time I used it. The gas leaked out at the seam and made more mess then if I hadn’t used the funnel. Gas all over my nice paint, what a piece of junkBuild heavy duty BUT, leaks at funnel neck. Fortunately as having over 49 years as a master mechanic. I always water test the funnels prior to use. Big funnels like this one are mostly used for farm tractors, ATV, Generators, etc. All center point fuel tanks. I learned the hard way in the past with an old but pristine Corvette. Fuel went all over the place. If you purchase one of these funnels. Cup the bottom with your hand, holding firmly. It leaks like colander! Very sad day for something that was made in the USA!I saw other reviews that said it leaked. Figured they got a bad one. It leaks around the seams.
Problem is you can't return it. Sticker on funnel says "quality galvanized ware since 1898" Also says made in USA. I bought and paid for a quality funnel. Did not get a quality product.
